gpu_tip: ~55GB total at 128K context, and the only rung whose MTP draft layers are not themselves quantized to Q4_0. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060 Ti 16GB) plus ~48GB of DDR5 system RAM covers it via llama.cpp's MoE offloading — no need for the BF16 build's 128GB ask.
mac_tip: Needs ~55GB — tight on a 64GB MacBook Pro; a 128GB M4 Max or M5 Max is the safe choice.
